entities.summary: Omar Ali Saifuddien III, a notable figure in the history of Brunei, associated with Path to Independence (1945–1962). Preceded by Post-War Reconstruction and Modernization. Their legacy influenced Brunei Revolt against proposed merger with Malaysia suppressed with British help and Brunei Revolt.
